posts.title: District of Squamish asks residents to limit indoor water use after wet B.C. weather
posts.description: The rain and wind warnings have been dropped across British Columbia's coast, but flooding is still a risk as other communities manage the aftermath.

posts.title: Sentencing hearing to continue for Kenneth Law, who admitted to aiding suicide
posts.description: A sentencing hearing is set to continue Friday for an Ontario man who sold potentially deadly substances online to people who then used those products to take their own lives.

posts.title: Premiers await Supreme Court ruling on Quebec’s secularism law
posts.description: Premiers across Canada are expected to be keeping a close eye on the Supreme Court Friday morning as it releases a ruling on the constitutionality of Quebec's secularism law.
